Worked with egg farmers in Kenya to improve laying hens' health and welfare through affordable feed fortification. It has since shut down. Ambitious Impact published 2 public models of its work; the most recent, from August 2020, puts it at **<span data-figure="headline" data-model="healthier-hens-aim">13</span> years of healthy life per $1,000**.
